description: This file manages feature opt-in state using local storage, including functions to get/set feature dismissal, opt-in timestamps, and feedback display status.

methods.name: getBooleanFeaturesMap
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean features map from local storage for a given key.

methods.name: getTimestampFeaturesMap
methods.description: Retrieves a timestamp features map from local storage for a given key.

methods.name: setBooleanFeatureInMap
methods.description: Sets a boolean feature value in the specified features map in local storage.

methods.name: setTimestampFeatureInMap
methods.description: Sets a timestamp feature value in the specified features map in local storage.

methods.name: isBooleanFeatureInMap
methods.description: Checks if a boolean feature is marked as true in the specified map.

methods.name: getFeatureOptInTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when a feature was opted in, or null if not set.

methods.name: isFeatureDismissed
methods.description: Checks if a feature has been dismissed.

methods.name: setFeatureOptedIn
methods.description: Records the current timestamp as the feature's opt-in time.

methods.name: isFeatureFeedbackShown
methods.description: Checks if feedback has been shown for a feature.

methods.name: setFeatureFeedbackShown
methods.description: Marks that feedback has been shown for a feature.
